rows.logline: A Seattle valet secretly owns the garage her father is about to lose. At the auction the clerk reads her name off the deed.
rows.doubt: Ownership is explicit; the reason for the auction is unstated.

rows.logline: A Seattle waitress keeps her ownership of the diner from her sister, who wants to sell it. At closing the buyer turns the license around and points to the waitress's name.
rows.evidence: keeps her ownership of the diner
rows.doubt: The sister could be acting in good faith.

rows.evidence: hides the fact that she owns

rows.logline: A student discovers her roommate has been auditioning under her name. The roommate gives her until curtain up to surrender the part or lose their apartment.
rows.doubt: Curtain up sets a deadline but leaves the scene location open.

rows.logline: A small-town surgeon comes home to expose the doctor who switched her patient's charts. He holds the surviving chart over a flame.
rows.evidence: comes home to expose the doctor

rows.logline: A violinist discovers her duet partner sold their only recording to pay his debts. The buyer knocks before she can confront him.
rows.evidence: duet partner sold their only recording
